svg.title: Meetings in Transcribe
svg.desc: Transcribe records a meeting, shows a live transcript beside your own notes, then writes a summary with decisions and next steps linked to the transcript.

g.text: Should dictation stay separate from meetings?
Yes. Keep them as two modes.
I'll send the cleanup notes this afternoon.
Good. We review the rest tomorrow.
Dictation and meetings stay separate. Cleanup notes go out
this afternoon and the next review is tomorrow.
Keep dictation and meeting recording as separate modes.
You · Send the cleanup notes this afternoon.
Unassigned · Review the remaining items tomorrow.
Record a call or a conversation
Get notes linked to the transcript
